chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Saeed al-A'raj, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Two angels make way for the people on the night of Muzdalifa at the two narrow points.
ai.seo_question: What role do angels play during the night of Muzdalifa in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the cosmological dimension of the Hajj, where two angels assist pilgrims at 'al-Ma'zimayn' (the two narrow places) on the night of Muzdalifa. Shia scholars often interpret this as a divine facilitation during the transition from Arafat, symbolizing spiritual ease and God's mercy in guiding believers through the critical stages of their pilgrimage.
